evidence: Body main_0082.c:16732 reads calendar_date, PitchUpgrade, attributes_updated, pitches_upgraded, if_pitch_group_upgrade, tokens_spent and tokens_remaining, copies the result fields, and applies player_attribute_get_float / attribute_record_value_get to the selected attribute data. Its caller at main_0082.c:13379 passes the result to this routine.

Body main_0111.c:12289 references substitution resource tables SUBSTITUTION_ManagerMode, SUBSTITUTION_Retro, SUBSTITUTION_CoopNonCapt and SUBSTITUTION_2P, plus LineUp_Table and Bench_Table. Available evidence does not identify the exact operation on these resources, and there is no indexed caller.

Body main_0032.c:29639 constructs frontend//rtts//Relationship.xml and invokes the XML/config helper family. Its caller at main_0032.c:29324 sets up RTTS config loading. The resolved log names the Relationship config and logs relationship scaling parameters.

Body main_0030.c:47279 opens AUDIO_MEM_MAPS/ and formats MemMap_NSW output names, then prints allocation/free/unused memory records with SNDMEM headers. Four callers at main_0031.c:1340, main_0076.c:2871 and :21074, and main_0093.c:42598 invoke the dump routine.

Body main_0081.c:53892 initializes a broad set of frontend UI resources including Background, CareerDecision, ClosedCaption, Dialog, GameNotification, Notification, OnlineChatView, Selection Box 2 and TeamSelect_Wheel. It calls ensure_global_attribute_registry_and_register_ids and dozens of resource/UI helpers. Exact lifecycle semantics are not visible, so name stays broad.

Body main_0128.c:30285 matches the embedded libwebp huffman_encode_utils.c routine. It uses ConvertBitDepthsToSymbols and GenerateOptimalTree stages, checks tree depth and maximum code length, and calls qsort. Two callers at 0x700116dee0 and 0x700116e1b0.

Body main_0108.c:38634 formats player attribute values with %.3f and composes output with newline and attribute labels. Seven callers pass attribute values and output contexts. This describes observed presentation behavior without asserting the exact UI widget.

Body main_0032.c:46164 loads frontend//rtts//MilestoneRewards.xml, initializes the config data and logs the RTTS Milestone Rewards asset. Caller main_0032.c:47196 tail-calls this routine as the config-loading step.

Body main_0057.c:43983 opens FRONTEND/Uniforms/MlbUniRules.json, traverses its JSON object and stores the result in uni_rules. Caller main_0057.c:43278 tail-calls this routine. The parser checks m_object and advances object iterators.

Body main_0084.c:44395 parses program_id and DATA_P_CURRENT_REWARD / DATA_PCURRENT_STAGE, then reads program stage, goals, rewards, extras, remaining_time and ticket/currency values. It resolves property-map values and formats signed integers. The body appears to construct program response data; exact command registration is not indexed, so this stays a medium-confidence name.
